scope: Paired full mixed-source scalar wake training with an additional conditional two-word CTC intent loss; reused development validation only.
objective: Original weighted binary BCE plus0.1*(paired two-token CTC NLL/2 + intent_gain*four-intent conditional CTC cross-entropy). Conditional classes use original synthesis intent and raw equal-prior CTC likelihoods for [hey,nyx|mix|next|nick],with no fitted score/length adjustment. Only the16 paired slots per128 mixed-source batch receive the new conditional term. Intent gain0/1 is the sole recipe difference;no background/ordinary-positive auxiliary targets or encoder caps are added.
warmup_policy: Both arms replay the original1000-step frozen-head CTC-only warmup exactly,including initial/final fits,head/cache/draw hashes and unchanged binary weights/optimizer. Conditional intent loss is excluded from warmup. Then both perform exactly3000 original mixed-source updates with the same draw schedule,augmentation,optimizer schedule and fixed final checkpoint. No gain/seed/step sweep or checkpoint search.

intent.objective: Paired original-intent cross-entropy over raw CTC likelihoods; no score/length correction. Added inside the existing auxiliary gain; omitted from frozen-head warmup and scalar export.

limits: Training uses only original training sources. Reused development validation is not untouched acceptance;synthetic source intent is not human pronunciation truth. The bank has5060 Cartesian pairs but only3112 distinct crops/744 source hashes,with unchanged pair-role/source weighting. New conditional intent supervision is training-only and discarded before the existing scalar INT8 export. No audio device,playback,microphone,board,firmware/OTA,PCM speed,or I2S/AEC/AGC/FIFO changes. Independent real-speaker/room recall,matched Hi ESP recognition/FAR/latency,P4 resources and long-call/reconnect stability remain required;no development pass alone completes the goal.
interpretation: The conditional word objective does not pass the unchanged development advancement screen. At the fixed .97 reference it changes engine-macro recall from 81.1458% to 81.8125%, while negative false clips increase from76 to83 and continuous events stay3/7.32382 hours. No treatment grid point has zero continuous events; minimum worst-group false fraction remains4.16667%. Fitted two-word CTC metrics do not establish open-set separation or independent pronunciation quality. This recipe is rejected without a gain/seed/step extension, reserved-quality scoring or firmware action.
